newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daika Sec says to sell Tokyo bourse membership.
newsitem.headline: Daika Sec says to sell Tokyo bourse membership.

text.p: Osaka-based brokerage Daika Securities Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would sell its membership of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) to a non-member securities house.
Last December Daika Securities had said it planned to merge with Tokyo-based Maruko Securities Co Ltd on October 1 this year.
Daika said on Tuesday that Maruko would sell its membership of the Osaka Securities Exchange to a non-member brokerage firm.
It has not yet been decided who will buy the memberships, Daika said.
Maruko will retain its membership of the TSE and will buy a seat on the Osaka bourse from Daika, the statement said.
Daika and Maruko are medium-sized brokers and their shares are not listed.
